statute_version_applicable: Cal. Civil Code §3294 (pre-1987 common law version)
rule_established: Conscious disregard malice framework: prior pattern of known dangerous conduct + subjective awareness of high probability of injury + willingness to proceed = §3294 malice
post_1987_status: Remains good law; Taylor's conscious disregard framework was codified by the 1987 amendment into §3294(c)(1)
verification_note: Cite with standard Westlaw or Lexis verification before use in filed documents
